Region Filling Algorithms
(Scan Line Polygon Filling Algorithm)

Recap of Lecture-14
❖ Summary-
❖We discussed two region fill algorithms:
❖Seed Fill algorithm 
❖Flood Fill Algorithm
❖Both the algorithms used for colouring a given graphic with a specified colour.
❖Flood fill is one in which all connected pixels of a selected colour get replaced 
by a specified colour.
❖ Seed fill algorithm (boundary-fill algorithm) stops when it founds a specified 
boundary colour.

Polygon Filling Algorithm
❖ Today we will discuss another algorithm, known as “SCAN LINE POLYGON 
FILL ALGORITHM” used for colouring regions defined geometrically. 
❖ The algorithm assumes that a region is defined in terms of their geometrical 
primitives (Geometrical Definition) i.e., region definition is given in terms of 
vertices and edges.

Scan Line Polygon Fill Algorithm

❖ So, while using scan line algorithm, we need to make sure that only 
pixels inside the polygon has to be coloured.
❖ Additional steps need to be invoked to decide the whether a pixel lies 
inside or outside of the region.
❖ Additional steps are as follows:
1. Determine the bounding box (max and min of x and y coordinates) 
for the polygon.
2. Choose a point 𝑝𝑜 outside the bounding box.  
3. To decide whether a point 𝑝 is inside or outside, join 𝑝 and 𝑝𝑜 and 
obtained the equation of line.
4. If the line intersect the polygon edges an even number of times, 
then 𝑝 is OUTSIDE else 𝑝 is INSIDE.
Scan Line Polygon Fill Algorithm

Fig. 1 : 𝑝 is INSIDE as line joining 𝑝 and 𝑝𝑜 it intersect the polygon Odd number of times

Character Rendering on Display 
Screen 
❖ Two ways to render characters on screen:
❑Bitmapped fonts :
▪ A pixel grid definition is maintained for each character.
▪In the grid, pixels that are the part of the character, marked as ON 
Pixels and others marked as OFF Pixels. 
❑Outlined fonts : 
▪In this approach, characters are defined in terms of the geometrical 
primitives such as vertex, lines, etc. 
▪Before rendering, the characters are scan converted
